amendments.description: Pursuant to the provisions of H. Res. 1438, in lieu of the amendment in the nature of a substitute recommended by the Committee on House Administration now printed in the bill, an amendment in the nature of a substitute consisting of the text of Rules Committee Print 119-38, modified by the amendment printed in part B of report 119-755, is considered adopted.

latestAction.text: On agreeing to the Rules amendment (A001) Agreed to without objection.
